# Workout Requirements Checklist: Workout Session Tracking

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of workout tracking requirements.
**Created**: 2026-11-20
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Does the spec define whether an exercise can contain fewer than three sets, given that three are prefilled and additional sets can be added? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the predefined exercise names and the meaning or allowed values of each exercise's muscle group fully specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004; data-model.md §ExerciseCatalog]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements for the session's default title specific about how its date/time and time-of-day label contribute to the title? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001; Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK004 Does the spec define what happens to unsaved form entries if the user leaves, reloads, or the application closes before saving? [Coverage, Spec §FR-017; Edge Cases]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Are the accepted weight precision and any practical upper bound defined, in addition to allowing zero and rejecting negative values? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006–FR-007]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the time-of-day boundaries unambiguous at every transition, including midnight and the exact start/end minute of each label? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013; data-model.md §WorkoutSession]
- [ ] CHK007 Is “under five seconds” defined with a repeatable measurement start point, end point, and evaluation population? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the 85% statement-coverage target defined with a consistent coverage denominator and clear boundaries for each named area? [Clarity, Spec §SC-007; plan.md §Technical Context]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 Are local date/time display requirements consistent with the timestamp and offset representation used to preserve the session's original local time? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002/FR-013; data-model.md §WorkoutSession]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the Pending/Completed terms and lifecycle rules consistent across session creation, resume, completion, history, and the data model? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003/FR-010/FR-022; data-model.md §WorkoutSession]
- [ ] CHK011 Are the API's JSON response requirement and the documented bodyless 204 deletion response treated consistently in all contract requirements? [Consistency, plan.md §Technical Context; contracts/openapi.yaml]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK012 Can every set validation outcome be objectively judged, including fractional weight, empty input, non-finite values, and invalid repetition counts? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-007/FR-018; SC-006]
- [ ] CHK013 Are the coverage goals for session creation, variable sets, status transitions, history editing, and deletion each traceable to explicit acceptance criteria? [Traceability, Spec §SC-007; User Stories 1–3]
- [ ] CHK014 Do the success criteria cover correct default naming, time-of-day labels, and status badges as well as persistence and task completion? [Coverage, Spec §SC-001–SC-007; FR-001/FR-012/FR-013/FR-021]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK015 Are simultaneous or rapidly repeated edits to the same session addressed, or explicitly excluded for the single-user local scope? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-015/FR-020]
- [ ] CHK016 Are recovery expectations defined for database initialization failure, interrupted writes, or local data corruption? [Recovery, Gap, plan.md §Constraints; quickstart.md]
- [ ] CHK017 Does the history requirement specify how users find a session as the unbounded session list grows, such as search, filtering, or pagination? [Clarity, Gap, Spec §FR-011; Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK018 Are deletion requirements clear about whether deleting a session permanently removes all associated exercise and set history? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016; data-model.md §Relationships and deletion]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK019 Are the yellow and green status badges also required to show text or another non-color cue for users who cannot distinguish the colors? [Accessibility, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK020 Are keyboard access, focus behavior, and accessible names specified for the fast set-entry and session-management workflows? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §User Stories 1–3]
- [ ] CHK021 Are local privacy and data protection expectations explicit for a device-local database with no sign-in? [Security, Spec §FR-020; plan.md §Constraints]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK022 Is the local runtime/startup expectation specified clearly enough that users know how the browser app reaches its loopback API? [Dependency, plan.md §Target Platform; quickstart.md]
- [ ] CHK023 Are cross-device sync, multi-user access, and user-managed catalog entries explicitly bounded as out of scope for v1? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Ambiguities and Conflicts

- [ ] CHK024 Is “the user can edit a session” clear about whether edits are allowed for both Pending and Completed sessions and which fields can change? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-015; Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK025 Is completion behavior clear for an empty session and for repeated completion requests, including the meaning of `completedAt`? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions; data-model.md §WorkoutSession]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- This custom checklist is separate from `requirements.md`, which is maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference.
